# ZingHR | Product Overview

ZingHR is an enterprise HCM that covers the entire life cycle of Hire-to-ReHire, focusing on India, the Middle East, Africa and South-East Asia. The core of the product is to create a unified workspace around staff, recruitment, pay/leave time or talent management, reducing fragmentation tools and manual maintenance.
